layers.name: Building Footprints (Research Stations)
layers.description: Permanent research station building footprints for isolation-from-infrastructure indicator.

layers.name: Human-made Linear Corridors
layers.description: Traverse routes and resupply corridors (1–2 km impact distance).

layers.name: ATS Land-based Visitor Sites
layers.description: All 331 ATS-reported coastal visitor sites with 5-year visit totals (2019/20–2023/24 seasons). Used for Remoteness and Wildness indicator scoring.

layers.name: Human Activity Footprints (Visitor Sites)
layers.source: Derived from ATS Visitor Sites — visit-weighted buffer polygons
layers.description: Impact footprint polygons derived from ATS visitor sites. Buffer radius (200–2000 m) scaled by log(total_visits_5yr). Used for Pristineness indicator.
layers.citation: ATS Visited Sites; Leihy et al. (2020) Nature 583:567–571

layers.name: Annual Visitation Records by Site
layers.description: Per-season visitation records (site × year) for 331 ATS visitor sites over 5 seasons. Only seasons with >0 visits included (743 records). Used for Pristineness inviolate area analysis.

layers.name: REMA DEM
layers.description: Reference Elevation Model of Antarctica for viewshed analysis. Synthetic DEM used when tiles unavailable.
layers.citation: Howat, I. et al. (2022). REMA v4.1. Harvard Dataverse. https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/X7NDNY

references: Summerson, R. (2012). Protection of Wilderness and Aesthetic Values in Antarctica.
Summerson, R. & Bishop, I.D. (2012). Polar Research, 31, 10858.
Kennicutt II, M.C. et al. (2010). Environ. Res. Lett. 5, 034010.
Leihy, R.I. et al. (2020). Antarctica's wilderness fails to capture continent's biodiversity. Nature 583:567–571.
Hughes, K.A. et al. (2011). Antarctic Science, 23(6), 537–548.
Howat, I. et al. (2022). REMA v4.1. Harvard Dataverse.
data_gaps: Deep-field tourism sites — no freely available dataset
Soundscape — audibility distances not quantified continent-wide
Night-sky light pollution at 50 km — not modelled
Station-specific pollutant thresholds — McMurdo only (Kennicutt et al. 2010)
Building footprints — COMNAP data requires institutional access; demo subset used
